Daily switch limit **per client per day** hoti hai, chahe woh ek order ho ya do alag-alag orders. Do orders mein 15,000 + 15,000 units split karke daily cap ko bypass karne ki koshish **allowed nahi hai**. Desk ka system same-day aggregate check karega aur dono block ho jayenge.

**Sahi tareeka:**
- Aaj **approx. 1,762 units** (₹10,00,000 limit ke andar) switch karein.
- Baaki units (approx. 28,238) **agle business day** switch karein.
